query:
SELECT f.account_id AS "account_id!"
        FROM follows f
        JOIN accounts a ON a.id = f.account_id
        WHERE f.target_account_id = $1 AND NOT f.pending
          AND a.suspended_at IS NULL
          AND (NOT a.hide_collections OR a.id = $4 OR $1 = $4)
        ORDER BY f.id DESC
        OFFSET $2 LIMIT $3
